title: Bond Voyage! Organic Reactions
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B organic reactions eight ways: Identify the Reaction; Pick the Product (multiple choice with drawn structures and mistake-specific feedback such as over-oxidation, anti-Markovnikov, swapped ester halves, acid vs base hydrolysis); Over the Arrow (pick the reagent and conditions); Roadmap (two reactions in a row, e.g. hydration then oxidation, or oxidation then esterification); Draw the Product; Draw the Reactant; Name It; and Full Reaction. A Body chemistry set adds real metabolic and drug reactions (pyruvate to lactate, fumarate to malate, malate to oxaloacetate, ethanol to acetaldehyde, a peptide bond, aspirin hydrolysis), and answers show short 'In the body' notes linking reactions to metabolism, digestion and medicines. Students draw on a built-in pad with automatic hydrogens and a lasso tool, in skeletal, condensed, expanded, or mixed structures. Covers alkanes and alkenes; alcohols, aldehydes, and ketones; and carboxylic acids, esters, amines, and amides. Naming accepts common alternate names. Includes a reaction reference, hints, answer reveals, XP, streaks, medal badges, named-mistake stats, and a Dr. Dan video matched to each question. Exam Practice: 157 final-exam style multiple-choice reaction questions from Final Boss.
